label: graphics
name: Graphics Image Category Classification
description: Classify a non-OCR graphic image into one or more detailed categories based on its visual structure, design purpose, shapes, patterns, data representation, and graphical composition.

labels.icon: An image primarily showing a simple pictorial icon representing an object, action, feature, or concept.
labels.symbol: An image primarily showing a recognizable visual symbol, sign, mark, or non-brand emblem.
labels.pattern: An image primarily showing a repeating decorative, geometric, floral, or abstract pattern.
labels.abstract_graphic: An image primarily showing non-representational shapes, lines, colors, gradients, or abstract visual forms.
labels.geometric_design: An image primarily showing an arranged composition of geometric shapes, lines, circles, polygons, or structured forms.
labels.decorative_graphic: An image primarily showing an ornamental visual design created for decoration rather than to represent a specific subject.
labels.diagram: An image primarily showing a visual arrangement of shapes, arrows, or connected components that explains a structure or relationship without important readable text.
labels.chart: An image primarily showing data visually using bars, lines, points, circles, or other chart forms without important readable text.
labels.map_graphic: An image primarily showing a designed, illustrated, or schematic map of a place, route, region, or area without important readable labels.
labels.background_design: An image primarily showing a decorative background, wallpaper, banner background, gradient, or visual backdrop.
labels.texture: An image primarily showing a surface texture or material pattern such as wood, stone, fabric, metal, paper, or an abstract texture.
labels.infographic_element: An image primarily showing a standalone visual element used in an infographic, such as arrows, timelines, process shapes, or data symbols.
